inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Well-plate schematics: direct ELISA (patient antigen + labeled antibody) vs indirect (patient antibody detected by labeled anti-Ig)

notes: The flow-cytometry instrument schematic is a KYP adaptation preserving the source's component set (cell, Anti-CD3/anti-CD8 antibodies with fluorescent labels, laser, detector, the two annotations). The quadrant plot is an original redraw preserving the source's log axes (10⁰–10⁴), axis assignment (X = CD8, Y = CD3), all four quadrant populations, and the source's empty-right-lower-quadrant explanation. The ELISA figure is an original redraw preserving both layer stacks (direct: antigen + labeled 1° antibody + enzyme + substrate → signal; indirect: antigen + 1° antibody + labeled 2° antibody + enzyme + substrate → signal).
